sections.title: Movable (Synovial) Joints
points: These joints are held together by ligaments and tendons.
They all contain synovial fluid to make them move smoothly.
The two most important types for PLE are Hinge and Ball-and-Socket.

sections.title: Special Details
points: Shoulder: Rounded head of the Humerus fits into the Scapula.
Hip: Rounded head of the Femur fits into the Pelvic Girdle.
The Knee: Sometimes called a 'modified hinge' because of the Patella (knee cap).

sections.text: The Ball and Socket joint provides the greatest range of motion in the human body, allowing for circular movement!

cards.mnemonic: Think of a door hinge—it only opens one way!
Like a ball sitting in a cup—it can roll in any direction!
